title: Single-layer low-profile high-gain wideband circularly polarized MIMO antenna for UAV applications
content:
by Hung Nguyen-Manh, Giang Nguyen-Hoai, Thai Nguyen-Dinh, Duy-Phong Pham, Nguyen Quoc Dinh

This paper presents a single-layer circularly polarized (CP) multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) antenna with wideband operation and high-gain radiation characteristics. The antenna comprises 16 truncated-corner patches arranged in a 4×4 configuration and capacitively excited by a probe-fed rectangular patch, enabling a low-profile single-layer structure. The final two-port MIMO antenna has a low profile of approximately 0.02λ at the lowest operating frequency. The measured results demonstrate an effective operating bandwidth of 5.16–5.68 GHz, corresponding to 9.6%, with isolation better than 19 dB and a peak gain of 9.4 dBi. In addition, the antenna exhibits good diversity performance in terms of envelope correlation coefficient (ECC), channel capacity loss (CCL), and mean effective gain (MEG). These results confirm that the proposed antenna is a promising candidate for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) communication systems.
author: Hung Nguyen-Manh
